text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hussein meets Israeli Foreign Minister David Levy and stresses his "rejection of all attempts to empty the Middle East peace process of substance."
- Crown Prince Hassan calls for a positive view "that ensures peace and prosperity for nations of the region."
- Japan tells Prime Minister Kabariti it wants just and comprehensive peace in the region.

- Jordan and Israel make noticeable progress in bilateral ties with long-delayed implementation of articles of their 1994 peace treaty, but Israeli Foreign Minister David Levy's visit fails to narrow wide differences over Israeli settlements in the West Bank and the commitment to the peace process.
- Final statement of the Arab political parties conference held in Amman calls for lifting of embargoes on Arab states and convening an Arab summit to confront Israel.
